title: NATSExcel configuration
description: Schema for NATSExcel.json. Comments (// and /* */) are accepted by the loader. Values that do not match are dropped individually (the rest of the file is kept).

Default.description: The endpoint a formula uses when it passes none: a Clusters name, a Servers name, or a raw nats:// URL.

Servers.description: Server aliases: name -> a nats:// URL or a comma-separated URL list.

Clusters.description: Named clusters: a set of URLs (Server aliases or inline URLs) plus optional overrides.

urls.description: Server aliases or inline nats:// URLs.

expectCluster.description: Optional: assert the cluster name the server announces (warning only).

maxAttempts.description: Reconnect attempts. -1 (or 0) means unlimited: the NATS client bounds the retries only for a positive value, so there is no way to ask for "no retry at all" through this key.

waitMs.description: Fixed wait between reconnection attempts, in milliseconds. This is the whole wait: it is applied as both the minimum and the maximum, so the delay does not grow past it (jitterMs spreads it). 0 leaves the client's own schedule: 2 s doubling to its 5 s ceiling.

Auth.description: Shared connection credentials; a cluster may override them field by field.

Reconnect.description: Shared reconnection defaults; a cluster may override them.

maxAttempts.description: Reconnect attempts. -1 (or 0) means unlimited: the NATS client bounds the retries only for a positive value, so there is no way to ask for "no retry at all" through this key.

waitMs.description: Fixed wait between reconnection attempts, in milliseconds. This is the whole wait: it is applied as both the minimum and the maximum, so the delay does not grow past it (jitterMs spreads it). 0 leaves the client's own schedule: 2 s doubling to its 5 s ceiling.

NatsUpdateRateMs.description: How often the poll timer reads NATS.

ExcelUpdateRateMs.description: How often dirty values are flushed to Excel.

MessageCounterThreshold.description: Messages/second above which Automatic switches to timer delivery.

cluster.description: Optional RTD endpoint override (a Clusters/Servers name or a URL); unset falls back to Default.

UDF.description: Optional UDF-only overrides. There is no separate connection pool (one NatsConnection multiplexes everything); only the default endpoint may be overridden here.

cluster.description: Optional UDF endpoint override; unset falls back to Default.

enabled.description: Whether JetStream features are used at all.

SkipRepeatedMessages.description: Skip identical consecutive payloads for literal subjects and polled reads.

CoalesceRealtimeUpdates.description: Real-time: at most one push per window (superseded by an explicit ConflationMs).

ConflationMs.description: Real-time conflation window in ms (0 = off; negative clamps to 0, >3600000 caps via Sanitize).

PublishDedupCacheSize.description: Capacity of the PublishIfChanged dedup cache (LRU).

AsyncWrites.description: Dispatch writes through Excel-DNA async so the Excel thread never blocks.

UpdateCheck.description: Check GitHub for a newer release in the background.
